title: Sunday Girl
feel: Bright eighth-note pop strum, about 126 bpm (estimate); modulates up to E

sections.name: Verse (in D)
sections.bars: D | G A | D | G A | D
sections.note: Continues on the same pattern; follow the record.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.bars: G | D | G | E . A B
sections.note: The pivot: A → B sets up the new key, E. Last-bar rhythm approximate.

sections.name: Verse (in E)
sections.bars: E | A B | E | A B | E | A B | C#m
sections.note: The E–(A B) pair repeats as long as the verse needs; the phrase ends on C♯m.

why: **E- and A-shape barres away from open position** (C♯m, G♯m, F♯, B) and a **whole-step key change**.
hard_change: **C♯m (A-shape, 4th fret) → G♯m (E-shape, 4th fret) → F♯ (E-shape, 2nd fret)**. The index stays at fret 4 for the first change.
theory: D → E through V/V (A–B in the pre-chorus). In E the bridge is iii (G♯m) – II (F♯, V/V) – IV – V.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: C♯m → G♯m → F♯ → A → B.
caveat: Two tabs agree on the plan; the original key is reported as D or C (a transposed edition) — this chart uses D.
